message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake. Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake, 2 layers) | Notes | |------------|----------------------------------------------|-------| | All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb. | | Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process or natural cocoa. | | Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Can be replaced with brown sugar for a richer flavor. | | Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise. | | Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for leavening. | | Salt | ½ tsp | Balances sweetness. | | Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature for better emulsion. | | Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room‑temperature; can substitute with buttermilk or almond milk. | | Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | ½ cup (120 ml) | Oil keeps the cake moist; butter adds flavor. | | Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for depth. | | Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a tender crumb. | | Optional extras | | • 1 tsp espresso powder (enhances chocolate flavor)
• ¼ cup chocolate chips or chopped chocolate (for a richer texture)
• Pinch of sea salt (brightens sweetness) | **Basic Steps:** 1. Preheat your oven to 350 °F (175 °C). Grease and flour two 9‑inch round pans (or line with parchment). 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 3. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla. Beat on medium speed until smooth. 4. Stir in boiling water (the batter will be thin). 5. Pour evenly into prepared pans. 6. Bake 30–35 min, or until a toothpick comes out clean. 7. Cool in pans 10 min, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your chocolate cake!
